title: Chapter 182 Zhao Tianze Attacks
content:
Chapter 182 Zhao Tianze Attacks

"Quick, get close!"

All the soldiers, not caring about their wounded companions, had to continue to rush forward.

Another round of spears came, and they were no longer as panicked as at the beginning.

However, before they got close to the bronze crossbow cart, they heard the rumbling sound of horse hooves.

An officer looked back and said in shock: "Yes, it's the cavalry."

"Everyone be careful!"

However, the charging cavalry was not something they could resist just by saying "be careful".

The warriors of Fengze Village were generally of low level, and they had not experienced too many battles.

And the conquest of other villages was basically based on the advantage of numbers, and the other side surrendered directly before they had fought much.

It was nothing like the Golden Fire Cavalry, which had wiped out tens of thousands of undead.

The average level of the Golden Fire Cavalry was almost level 20, while the average level of the soldiers of Fengze Village was only level 10, and there were even many recruits who were only level 5 or 6.

Especially the militia at the back, who had never experienced any decent battles.

Seeing the cavalry rushing forward with great momentum, I was directly scared to death!

Soldiers with low levels and low health points were even killed instantly by Ayub.

The super combat power of the cavalry was something no one had expected.

Wang Shuo had not expected it, and Zhao Tianze had not expected it even more.

In the last battle, Zhao Tianze thought it was a conflict between the two types of soldiers, but this time, he realized it clearly.

It is not impossible for an invincible army to fight against a hundred with one.

Zhao Tianze saw it with his eyes and was anxious in his heart.

The troops that Ayub chose to charge were the weakest militia.

The shield soldiers and sword soldiers at the front did not suffer serious losses at present.

When the shield soldiers approached, the Black Mountain bandits immediately wrapped the crossbow battalion in the center and protected it.

The two sides fell into a hand-to-hand fight.

The Black Mountain bandits were born as bandits, and their level was also as high as level 20. After Wang Shuo replaced them with sophisticated equipment, although they were not elite, their combat effectiveness was already incomparable to the past.

Due to the level suppression, although the number of people is not dominant, the Black Mountain bandits can fight one against two, and they are not at a disadvantage at all.

When Ayub charged again, a large number of Fengze Village soldiers were trampled and killed.

Zhao Tianze, hiding behind the wall, couldn't figure out where he lost.

Is he really not the material to be a lord?

But, he is the son of destiny with a system!

At this time, he saw that the battle situation was unfavorable, and he didn't care about much. He directly took his only 200 archers and pressed forward.

The attack distance of the archers was only more than 200 meters, which was still a certain distance from the battlefield.

Wang Shuo saw from a distance that Zhao Tianze was not afraid and dared to fight in person, and he couldn't help but look up to him.

After another round of cavalry charge, Wang Shuo reined in his horse and joined the cavalry team.

"Let's go and destroy the opponent's archers." Wang Shuo roared and said to Ayub.

"Yes, Lord!"

Wait until the cavalry assembled again.

Wang Shuo turned to look at Ayub and asked, "How is your cavalry formation?"

"I have only comprehended 60%." Ayub held the reins in one hand and the Qinglong sword in the other. He looked mighty and domineering, but his face was a little embarrassed.

He suddenly felt a little embarrassed, thinking, Lord, you are talking about something else!

"This battle can't be counted on!" Wang Shuo smiled bitterly, clamped his legs tightly around the horse's legs, "Go!"

Zhao Tianze saw Wang Shuo rushing over aggressively, and although he was afraid in his heart, he still pretended to be calm.

"Shoot them to death." He immediately commanded the archers to attack the cavalry.
